data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight key features of Artemis including pipeline stages, cost tracking, and sandboxing with charts.
acceptance_criteria: 8-stage pipeline is visualized with Chart.js
Cost tracking is demonstrated with charts
Sandboxing and learning features are highlighted

features.title: Illustrate Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Use a radar chart to show TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is displayed with a radar chart
SOLID principles adherence is visualized
Chart is accurate and informative

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to show live metrics such as LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown with a line chart
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate results.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are included in the presentation
Data is current and relevant
Metrics are clearly displayed and understandable

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis self-demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML
Chart.js is included for data visualization

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across different stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Supervisor integration is visualized with a pie chart
Chart accurately represents integration across stages
Data is clear and easy to understand

features.title: Enhance with Animations and Interactivity
features.description: Incorporate Chart.js animations and interactive elements to make the presentation engaging.
acceptance_criteria: Charts include animations for transitions
Interactive elements are included for user engagement
Presentation remains responsive and functional

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with options for manual navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate through slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions into the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation has a gradient background
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional
Overall design is visually appealing
